security.title: Security
security.passwordHint: Once the new password is saved, all other devices are signed out of your account; you stay signed in on this device.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Devices signed in to your account. Signing out closes only the session on this device; sign out a device you don't recognise here.
sessions.ipHint: Devices on the same Wi-Fi network show the same IP.
sessions.emptyDescription: Devices signed in to your account appear here. If you signed in earlier, the session shows up at the next refresh (about once an hour).
sessions.truncated: Showing the latest {{shown}} · {{count}} active sessions in total

revoke.title: Confirm signing out the device
revoke.description: This device will be signed out of your account — on its next request it returns to the sign-in page. Signing in again needs the login and password.
revoke.descriptionExpired: This device's session will be closed and removed from the list. It has to sign in again anyway — signing in opens a new session.
revoke.error: Couldn't close the session. Please try again.

revokeOthers.action: Sign out of all other devices

revokeOthers.description: Other devices to sign out: {{count}} — on their next request they return to the sign-in page.
revokeOthers.reloginRequired: Couldn't identify this device's session. Sign out, sign in again and try once more.

lock.title: For security, other sessions can't be signed out from a new device.
